questions.question: A shipment is consistently recorded as delivered or cancelled. Should it still have active exception categories in this triage workflow?

Use only LATE_DELIVERY, STALE_TRACKING and FAILED_ATTEMPT_ADDRESS. Multiple categories may coexist. Failed/address subtypes are FAILED_ATTEMPT, ADDRESS_EXCEPTION or BOTH. TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE are distinct; missing facts are not false.

Physical failed attempts require valid ATTEMPT_FAILED event references and distinct attempt_id values within a shipment snapshot. Duplicate messages for one attempt count once. Missing identity/history leaves the affected count unknown. Complete history with zero failures and inactive address state has no failed/address exception. Failed-attempt history remains relevant until closure.

Each category owns classification, eligibility, evidence and blockers. A shipment-global blocker yields NEEDS_REVIEW.
